items.description: Tabaquite is a small village nestled in the central hills of Trinidad, known for its lush surroundings and agricultural roots.
Barataria is a bustling residential and commercial district located just east of Port of Spain.
Guayaguayare is a coastal community on the southeastern tip of the island, historically significant for early European exploration.
Manzanilla is a scenic coastal settlement famous for its extensive sandy beaches and coconut plantations.
Erin is a historic village located in the southwestern corner of Trinidad, known for its tranquil beaches and local heritage.
Tableland is a hilly agricultural community in south-central Trinidad, widely recognized for its fruit and crop cultivation.
Goldsborough is a coastal village in Tobago, characterized by its natural beauty and connection to local marine ecosystems.
Belle Garden is a small, quiet community in Tobago known for its lush greenery and traditional lifestyle.
Goodwood is a coastal village in Tobago, offering panoramic views of the Atlantic and a peaceful environment.
Castara is a picturesque fishing village on the leeward coast of Tobago, popular for its beautiful bay and local culture.
